_doc: Interactions people can perform on objects (T-0006). Exactly one of duration_minutes or until_need (with min_minutes and max_minutes). need_rates are per game hour and apply on top of normal decay (sleep's hunger/hygiene/fun/social rates make those needs fade more slowly overnight, T-0036); time_skip (optional) skips ahead while the player does it; routine (optional) "sleep" or "out" ties it to daily routines (T-0036); finish_needs are one-off gains at the end; advertise is what autonomy scoring expects. object_tags must each be used by at least one object in data/objects/.
